title.name: Title
title.value: A parent’s guide to Science and Technology, Grades 1–8 (2022)

content.name: Content
content.value: describe how different objects and materials interact with light and sound energy

content.name: Content
content.value: use a scientific research process and associated skills to conduct investigations

content.name: Content
content.value: use a scientific experimentation process and associated skills to conduct investigations

content.name: Content
content.value: use an engineering design process and associated skills to design, build, and test devices, models, structures, and/or systems

content.name: Content
content.value: follow established health and safety procedures during science and technology investigations, including wearing appropriate protective equipment and clothing and safely using tools, instruments, and materials

content.name: Content
content.value: communicate their findings, using science and technology vocabulary and formats that are appropriate for specific audiences and purposes

content.name: Content
content.value: write and execute code in investigations and when modelling concepts, with a focus on producing different types of output for a variety of purposes

content.name: Content
content.value: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life and in STEM-related fields

content.name: Content
content.value: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures

content.name: Content
content.value: identify and describe impacts of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life, including skilled trades

content.name: Content
content.value: describe practical applications of science and technology concepts in various occupations, including skilled trades, and how these applications address real-world problems

content.name: Content
content.value: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences

title.name: Title
title.value: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

content.name: Content
content.value: assess the impacts on society and the environment of technological innovations related to light and sound

content.name: Content
content.value: investigate how science and technology can be used with other subject areas to address real-world problems

content.name: Content
content.value: analyse contributions to science and technology from various communities

title.name: Title
title.value: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

content.name: Content
content.value: assess impacts of human activities on habitats and communities, and analyse actions for minimizing negative impacts and enhancing positive ones

content.name: Content
content.value: demonstrate an understanding of habitats and communities and of interrelationships among the organisms that live in them

content.name: Content
content.value: assess positive and negative impacts of human activities on habitats and communities, while taking different perspectives into account

content.name: Content
content.value: analyse the impact of the depletion or extinction of a species on its habitat and community, and describe possible actions to prevent such depletions or extinctions

content.name: Content
content.value: describe habitats as areas that provide organisms, including plants and animals, with the necessities of life, and identify ways in which a local habitat provides these necessities

content.name: Content
content.value: describe a community as a group of interacting species sharing a common habitat, and identify factors that affect the ability of a community of plants and animals to survive in a local habitat

content.name: Content
content.value: describe the relationship of organisms in a food chain, and classify organisms as producers, consumers, or decomposers

content.name: Content
content.value: demonstrate an understanding of a food web as the interconnection of multiple food chains in a natural community

content.name: Content
content.value: describe how animals are categorized according to their diet, and categorize various animals as carnivores, herbivores, or omnivores

content.name: Content
content.value: describe structural adaptations of a variety of plants and animals and how these adaptations allow the organisms to survive in specific habitats

content.name: Content
content.value: explain why all habitats have limits to the number of plants and animals they can support

content.name: Content
content.value: assess the impacts on society of devices that use the properties of light or sound, or both

content.name: Content
content.value: assess the impacts on the environment of light energy and sound energy produced by various technologies, while taking different perspectives into account

content.name: Content
content.value: identify a variety of natural and artificial light sources

content.name: Content
content.value: demonstrate an understanding of light and sound as forms of energy that have specific characteristics and properties

title.name: Title
title.value: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

content.name: Content
content.value: evaluate the impacts of various machines and their mechanisms on society and the environment

content.name: Content
content.value: distinguish between objects and living things that emit their own light and those that reflect light from other sources

content.name: Content
content.value: describe properties of light, including that light travels in a straight path and that light can be absorbed, reflected, and refracted

content.name: Content
content.value: describe properties of sound, including that sound travels through a medium as a wave and that sound can be absorbed or reflected and modified

content.name: Content
content.value: explain how vibrations cause sound waves

content.name: Content
content.value: assess the impacts of machines and their mechanisms on the daily lives of people in various communities

content.name: Content
content.value: assess and compare the environmental impacts of using different machines designed for similar purposes

content.name: Content
content.value: identify machines that are used in daily life, and describe their purposes

content.name: Content
content.value: demonstrate an understanding of the basic principles and functions of machines and their mechanisms

title.name: Title
title.value: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

content.name: Content
content.value: assess the social and environmental impacts of geological processes and of human uses of rocks and minerals

content.name: Content
content.value: identify the parts of various mechanisms and describe the purpose of each part

content.name: Content
content.value: describe how different mechanisms transmit various types of motion, including rotary motion, from one system to another

content.name: Content
content.value: describe how mechanisms transform motion, including how they can change the geometric plane in which the motion occurs and the speed and/or direction of motion

content.name: Content
content.value: explain how forces are changed in a variety of machines

content.name: Content
content.value: distinguish between sources of light that emit both light and heat and those that emit light but little heat

content.name: Content
content.value: identify sensory organs and devices that make use of the properties of light and sound

content.name: Content
content.value: analyse ways in which geological processes impact society and the environment

content.name: Content
content.value: assess social and environmental impacts of extracting and refining rocks and minerals and of manufacturing, recycling, and disposing of products derived from rocks and minerals, while taking various perspectives into account

content.name: Content
content.value: explain geological processes that result in the formation of igneous, sedimentary, and metamorphic rocks, using the rock cycle

content.name: Content
content.value: demonstrate an understanding of rocks, minerals, and Earth’s geological processes

content.name: Content
content.value: describe the physical properties of igneous, sedimentary, and metamorphic rocks

content.name: Content
content.value: classify different rocks and minerals according to their composition and physical properties, using various tests and criteria

content.name: Content
content.value: describe everyday uses of rocks and minerals

content.name: Content
content.value: describe how fossils are formed and what information they can provide about Earth’s history

content.name: Content
content.value: demonstrate an understanding of First Nations, Métis, and Inuit geological knowledges that are used in the selection of different rocks and minerals for specific purposes
